metadata.creator: Coco Hotahota & Temaeva
metadata.description:
1976 LP released by French Polynesian musician Coco Hotahota (1941-2020) and "His Tahitian Group Temaeva".

He released several albums, with and without Temaeva, from the 1970s through at least the late 1990s.

Several documentaries about Hotahota have been released, include Coco Hotahota Te Maeva in 2019 and Coco Hotahota farereiraa in 2022.
